scope: Resolved publication identities and complete MED abstracts read. Selected consensus definitions/parameters/success-follow-up sections and microwave mechanisms read, not every article. Device power/time/temperature, coverage and viability are not interchangeable. Calf-liver experiment is ex vivo; six-test-swine kidney rim and proposed renal margin are not a universal human boundary. Historical freezing advice/device inventory are not adopted as current prescriptions.

Consensus definition, assay and in-vivo model/clinical interpretation sections read. DAMPs, apoptosis or peripheral markers do not alone establish protective adaptive immunity; mouse vaccination is not established human disease. No immune-optimal dose inferred.

2005 handbook sections 2.5, 14.4, 14.6, 14.7 and 14.8 read for units, damage, repair and model context. Additional PDF filename carries a retrieval label, but its own title/copyright resolves it to IAEA 2013 Human Health Reports 6; only Appendix XI BED model passage used. BED-versus-delivery distinction is an explicit educational inference from model and technical-delivery definitions. No numeric BED equivalence, safe distance, personal dose plan or old clinical threshold adopted. ASTRO technical consensus and Timmerman peripheral-inoperable setting are limited to complete available abstracts.

Complete MED identities/abstracts read. START-A/pilot planned meta-analysis provides endpoint-specific uncertain alpha/beta; START-B and five-year FAST-Forward use exact populations/regimens/endpoints. No arbitrary five-visit, nodal, reirradiation or immune-optimal equivalence.

Complete MED abstracts and selected full-text methods/results/population/endpoint/harms sections read, not every supplement. BOOSTER 65 randomised/62 main analysis, PFS before randomisation, separate randomisation clock, exploratory modality selection and separate 97-person cytokine cohort retained. Overall-survival interval/test and thermal-subgroup count conflicts are disclosed. CURB primary journal report overrides review histology shorthand, not its quoted abstract. NRG-BR002 eligible population, 95% versus 70% intervals and one-sided/stratified tests stay distinct. PACIFIC original primary versus 2022 updated cutoff/follow-up remain separate; five-year survival is not cure.

Complete available MED abstracts; selected B-51 population, methods/fields, events, isolated-cell caveat and follow-up context and Z0011 methods/results/limitations read. B-51 full report defines clinical N1 anatomically, not as pathological 1-3 nodes; ypN0i+ allowed but no subgroup frequency/outcome collected. Z0011 available abstract/full text first-report-year wording conflicts with its cited bibliography; overview omits that year rather than guesses. Surgery-first evidence does not answer A011202 residual disease. AMAROS 2014 and ten-year 2023 abstract versions stay separate. IASLC traditional R definitions and lung proposal do not universalise breast margin standards. Other retained quantitative breast margin standards are not newly certified.

FDA nonclinical guidance exposure/dosimetry context read; not a universal clinical protocol. Exact July 2026 PSMA product/diagnostic/ARPI/disease announcement is a dated example, not an exhaustive current label or cross-cancer indication. 2023 joint EANM/SNMMI selection/dosimetry sections and complete MED abstract read; then-approved fixed activity/nonmandatory individual dosimetry and unconfirmed adaptation benefit remain scoped. European legal text is not adopted as current legal advice.

NCI table returned HTTP 200 challenge content and supplies no claim. Original SIR PDF had TLS failure; same DOI/PMID full-text PMC alternative used. Two Crossref 429 failures leave those discovery identifiers unverified and unused as load-bearing evidence.
Screened discovery follow-ups only at per-occurrence depth. Complete available MED abstracts or Crossref posted-content abstract read; no absent full-text or clinical validation claimed.

Four new paper identities independently resolved through NCBI ESummary and read; titles, years and DOIs agree with the resolved MED records. The existing parser appends only these four to paper-ids.json, preserving every legacy entry and the legacy snapshot date. Current retrieval time/hash is recorded here, not claimed for old entries.
